chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Abu Sa'id al-'Usfuri, from 'Amr ibn Thabit, from Abu Hamzah, who said:

I heard 'Ali ibn al-Husayn (عليه السلام) saying: Indeed Allah created Muhammad and 'Ali and eleven from his descendants from the light of His magnificence. Then He established them as forms in the radiance of His light, worshipping Him before the creation of creation. They glorified Allah and declared His holiness, and they are the Imams from the descendants of the Messenger of Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله).

key_terms.أَشْبَاحًا: subtle forms or likenesses established in the divine radiance
key_terms.نُورِ عَظَمَتِهِ: the light of Allah's magnificence from which they were created
key_terms.وُلْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ: the descendants of the Messenger of Allah
key_terms.يَعْبُدُونَهُ: worshipping Him before the creation of creatures

ai.seo_question: What does al-Kafi narrate about the creation of Muhammad, 'Ali, and the twelve Imams from divine light?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the pre-creation luminous origin of Muhammad, 'Ali, and the eleven Imams from his descendants, presenting them as worshippers of Allah before the creation of the rest of creation. It emphasizes their unique ontological rank and identifies them as the Imams from the progeny of Rasul Allah (صلى الله عليه وآله).

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Ahmad, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abu Saeed Al Usfoury, from Amro Bin Sabit, from Abu Hamza who said,

‘I heard Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Created Muhammad<sup>saww</sup> and Ali<sup>asws</sup> and eleven from his<sup>asws</sup> sons<sup>asws</sup> from the Light of His<sup>azwj</sup> Magnificence. Then He<sup>azwj</sup> Stood them<sup>asws</sup> as being resemblances in the illumination of His<sup>azwj</sup> Light, worshipping Him<sup>azwj</sup> before the creation of the creatures. They<sup>asws</sup> were Glorifying Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and they<sup>asws</sup> were Extolling His<sup>azwj</sup> Holiness, and they<sup>asws</sup> are the Imams<sup>asws</sup> from the children of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 6. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from abu Sa‘id al-‘Usfuriy from ‘Amr aaand ibn Thabit from abu Hamza who has said the following.

“I heard Ali ibn al-Husayn say, ‘Allah created Muhammad , Ali and the eleven Imams from his descendants out of the light of His greatness. He then placed them as figures in the brightness of His light where they worshipped Him before the creation of the creatures. They would speak of the Glory of Allah and of His Holiness. They are the Imams from descendants of the Messenger of Allah.”
